sloka: मूर्ध्नि स्थास्याम्यहम् यत्तो लक्ष्मणेन समन्वितः ।जाम्बवाम्श्च सुषेणश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः ॥६-२४-१७॥।।
transliteration: mūrdhni sthāsyāmyaham yatto lakṣmaṇena samanvitaḥ ।jāmbavāmśca suṣeṇaśca vegadarśī ca vānaraḥ ॥6-24-17॥।।

translations.english: "I and Lakshmana will be alert at the head side. Let Jambavan Sushena and the three chiefs of Bears who are strong and quick at sighting remain protecting the belly of the army."
